records.title: PHASE8-IMPL-026 Parent Identity
records.question: What roadmap identity should govern Project Memory and Plan Integrity?
records.selected_option: PHASE8-IMPL-026 is the authoritative roadmap parent for Project Memory and Plan Integrity. Classification: hybrid governance, documentation, and developer infrastructure.
records.rationale: A separate parallel governance workstream publishes controlling policies before any schema, scanner, registry, renderer, or retrieval tool exists. Project Memory must not silently override the accepted roadmap.

records.title: JSON Canonical Registry Format
records.question: What canonical tracked registry format should Project Memory use?
records.selected_option: JSON as the canonical tracked Project Memory registry format. Reasons: Python standard-library parsing, direct compatibility with JSON Schema, deterministic serialization, no new YAML dependency, exact value types, easier automated validation.
records.rationale: YAML would add a new dependency, complicate diff-based review, and introduce ambiguous type coercion. JSON with JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 provides the formal machine-readable data contract.

records.title: Tracked Registry Paths
records.question: Where should tracked Project Memory documentation, implementation code, tests, and generated evidence live?
records.selected_option: Tracked decisions: docs/roadmap/decisions/. Tracked documentation and registries: docs/project-memory/. Implementation code: scripts/project_memory/. Tests: tests/project_memory/. Generated evidence and indexes: .codex-context/project-memory/.
records.rationale: Clear separation of tracked source registries and generated index/build output. Generated artifacts are not authority.

records.title: Generated Evidence Root
records.question: What directory should hold generated Project Memory evidence and indexes?
records.selected_option: .codex-context/project-memory/ as the generated evidence and index root. Generated documentation sites and indexes are ignored build output and are not authority.
records.rationale: Consistent with existing .codex-context/ conventions. Generated artifacts are evidence only and must not be confused with tracked source registries.

records.title: Complete-Commit Synchronization Policy
records.question: What branch synchronization policy should govern Project Memory?
records.selected_option: Complete-commit synchronization from clean worktrees at defined checkpoints. Reject path-filtered cherry-picking, roadmap-only copying, and destructive workflows. Prefer reviewed full merge; complete-commit cherry-pick when owner selects a precise accepted commit. Every memory snapshot records the accepted application commit.
records.rationale: Path-filtered synchronization would leave code and tests stale, making plan-vs-implementation comparison impossible. Complete-commit sync ensures every memory snapshot has a complete known-good state.

records.title: Tool Pilots Deferred Until Deterministic Foundation
records.question: When should Serena, LlamaIndex, and Qdrant pilots begin?
records.selected_option: Tool installation work is contingent on provenance and benchmark decisions. Serena, LlamaIndex, and Qdrant are not approved dependencies. Pilots deferred until after deterministic foundation (T001-T005) exists.
records.rationale: Premature dependency declaration could introduce network access, file-write scope, or subprocess behavior without review. The deterministic foundation must exist before retrieval pilots can compare against known-good baseline state.

records.title: T006/T007 Deferred for No Measured Capability Gap
records.question: Should T006 Serena or T007 LlamaIndex/local-embedding/Qdrant Local be activated without a measured capability gap?
records.selected_option: Defer both pilots. Keep T006 and T007 contingent, planned, inactive, and unimplemented. T008 proceeds using deterministic Project Memory sources and ordinary read-only repository access. Deferral is not rejection and does not approve later installation.
records.rationale: No concrete symbol-navigation, retrieval-quality, citation, scale, latency, or maintainability gap has been measured. T005's zero-artifact result reflects worktree topology, not a Serena or vector-retrieval deficiency. Reconsider only after a documented benchmarkable gap is observed and a future owner-approved provenance/benchmark task is opened.

records.title: Q154 Event-Driven Commit-Bound Operational Cadence
records.question: What operational synchronization cadence should govern the Project Memory branch and deterministic refresh?
records.selected_option: Use an event-driven, commit-bound cadence. Refresh after every accepted application-commit synchronization, completed Project Memory task or tracked authority/registry/tooling change, before parent/phase closeout publication, and whenever deterministic stale detection reports repository divergence. No cron or time-based schedule is required.
records.rationale: Commit, source, registry, binding, semantic, authority, inventory, checksum, and quality divergence determine freshness. Time passage alone does not stale a commit-bound publication. Synchronization remains an explicit owner/operator-controlled Git action.

records.title: Remaining-MVP Deterministic Execution Routing and Shared UI Guidance
records.question: Which executor class, model category, reasoning/risk lane, owner-only boundary, and shared UI guidance govern each remaining authoritative MVP task?
records.selected_option: Use the accepted owner classifications normalized in execution-routing.json; keep T007B owner-only; require the shared Impeccable-backed UI skill for every UI task; fail closed on missing, conflicting, stale, inapplicable, inactive, or dependency-ineligible resolution.
records.rationale: A committed resolver prevents agent judgment, conversation memory, generated recommendations, or historical routing from silently choosing execution authority.

records.title: Inherited-Leaf Execution-Routing Repair
records.question: May a validated allowlisted leaf inherit a delegable executor route from a correctly nondelegable aggregate record?
records.selected_option: Yes. Set delegation eligibility on the resolved leaf after validating exact inheritance, leaf status, conflicts, and owner boundaries; keep the aggregate and owner-only records nondelegable and preserve every later fail-closed eligibility gate.
records.rationale: This implements the T012 assignment for T003B/T003C and the same accepted T004/T005/T006 pattern without an explicit one-off record or any weakening of ROUTING-012.

records.title: Whole Remaining MVP Plan Integrity Conclusions
records.question: Which bounded council planning conclusions should become authoritative roadmap and Project Memory state?
records.selected_option: Accept the consolidated PHASE8-IMPL-024 order, PHASE8-IMPL-025 activation and branched dependency model, bounded API/UI/compatibility/NCP additions, T005/T006 provisioning, validation reuse, and PHASE8-IMPL-027 terminal acceptance gate. Preserve later component, migration, export, retention/deletion, destructive-operation, candidate-bundle, and final accept/reject/defer decisions as pending.
records.rationale: The checksum-verified council package is advisory generated evidence; the owner's explicit bounded acceptance supplies authority without accepting unrelated implications or authorizing implementation.
